exec echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/kgs/sweep_fixed.sh && grep -q '^#!/usr/bin/env bash' /tmp/kgs/sweep_fixed.sh && grep -c 'su 0 sh -c' /tmp/kgs/sweep_fixed.sh && touch /tmp/kgs/sweep/STOP && sleep 6 && { pkill -f '/tmp/kgs/sweep.sh' || :; } && sleep 2 && echo OLD-SWEEPER:$(pgrep -af 'sweep.sh' | grep -v fixed | tr '\n' ' ') && rm -f /tmp/kgs/sweep/STOP && adb -s 127.0.0.1:5555 shell am force-stop jp.konami.pesam && sleep 3 && { nohup bash /tmp/kgs/sweep_fixed.sh >> /tmp/kgs/sweep.log 2>&1 </dev/null & sleep 5 && { adb -s 127.0.0.1:5555 shell am start -W -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER -n jp.konami.pesam/com.epicgames.ue4.GameActivity || :; }; } && sleep 8 && echo SEQUENCE-DONE && echo NEW-SWEEPER:$(pgrep -af 'sweep_fixed' | tr '\n' ' ') && echo GAMEPID:$(adb -s 127.0.0.1:5555 shell pidof jp.konami.pesam | tr -d '\r') && echo SWEEP-DIR:$(du -sh /tmp/kgs/sweep | cut -f1) && tail -6 /tmp/kgs/sweep.log
